anomalies.finding: The first iteration replaces the full random activation pool with 50 rows; all 20 runs thereafter use the same negative identity set per concept. Different concepts can choose different first sets.
anomalies.possible_impact: The stated independent-negative-run interpretation is false; TCAV significance cannot be interpreted as 20 independent negative pools.

anomalies.possible_impact: Changes available segments, clustering and evaluation coverage; source fidelity is not algorithmic correctness.
anomalies.handling: Record upstream behavior in any authorized code-reference baseline; an all-label correction requires an explicit separate protocol.

anomalies.affected_scope: C preparation / future baseline; shared B boundary where noted

anomalies.affected_scope: C preparation / future baseline; shared B boundary where noted
anomalies.finding: Paired t-test compares run indices although negative sets are not paired across concepts/control. TCAV uses negative directional derivatives of cross-entropy, not positive derivatives of the target logit.

inventory_receipt_schema.title: Baseline preparation parent inventory facts, schema_version1

limits.description: Record depth, file-count, size and timeout limits; absent files outside scope cannot be called absent.

inventory_receipt_rules: All remote enumeration, decoding, hashing and array processing happen within the recorded Slurm job. Scheduler read-only queries may be run by the parent using its authenticated SSH master.
A bounded initial name/metadata scan may leave counts and identity fields null. Null means not checked, never zero. Do not trigger costly extraction solely to populate this schema.
Name-only candidates are not validated caches or selected pools; actual pool selection still requires user policy judgment.
A COMPLETE scan means complete within declared scope, not all Bunya storage. Empty findings outside an incomplete/limited scope cannot prove absence.

For pool manifests, rows must contain source_id, synset, split, source/input paths, SHA256, mode/format outcome and role/selection order if known. Include frozen input overlap checks by original identity and content.

For caches, record method-specific row mapping, zero filtering, shapes/dtypes, weight/preprocessing/precision and SSC q/normalization. Unknown producer identity requires UNKNOWN/CANDIDATE, not VERIFIED.
Do not deserialize untrusted pickle merely to inventory a path; headers/manifests can be inspected safely and missing identity reported.

Archive scheduler and inventory receipts locally with hashes; link all warnings/errors to the unified anomaly registry. User-provided scheduler facts remain attributed until raw receipts are attached.
